acs.text_first_line: AC1 The record writes the method, the time and the reference, and its values are checked against the lists and the case
AC2 The record and its event are one transaction, and a failed write moves nothing
AC3 A decline and a wet ink paper result record NOT_SIGNED and SIGNED with their method
AC4 The offer validity closes the window and a later record changes nothing
AC5 A repeated record writes once and is counted
AC6 An unknown reference or a treatment not with the customer writes nothing
AC7 The signature state shows on SCR-14 through the composite route
AC8 The guard refuses a role without the right and no personal value is written, published or logged
